title: Change glossary term Vacant unit: plg:Vacant_v2 → plg:Vacant_v3

term.definition: Lettable unit with no active or committed tenancy, including units under tender.

source.locator: Glossary change 75b05dbf-4656-4549-9e5e-7a8da28d88cf, proposed by S02: Management Meeting 5/2026 aligned the monthly report with the QBR.

previous.definition: Lettable unit with no active or committed tenancy, excluding units under tender. Units under tender and units not lettable are reported separately. Historical figures are not restated.

source.locator: Minutes of PLG Management Meeting No. 4/2026, item 3
source.quote: from the April 2026 report, 'vacant' means units with no active or committed tenancy that are lettable and NOT under tender.

payload.reason: Management Meeting 5/2026 aligned the monthly report with the QBR.
payload.sql:
SELECT u.unit_id, u.status, u.vacant_since
FROM units u
WHERE u.status IN ('Vacant', 'Under Tender') AND u.vacant_since <= $as_of

preview:
Vacant unit (plg:Vacant)

Now (plg:Vacant_v2, in force from 2026-04-15): Lettable unit with no active or committed tenancy, excluding units under tender. Units under tender and units not lettable are reported separately. Historical figures are not restated.

Proposed (plg:Vacant_v3, from 2026-10-01): Lettable unit with no active or committed tenancy, including units under tender.

Value: excludes units under tender → includes units under tender

Reason: Management Meeting 5/2026 aligned the monthly report with the QBR.

On approval: plg:Vacant_v2 is superseded (in force until the day before) and kept.
